5479.title: Persistent Claude discovery retains previous tool contracts
5479.rootCauseOneLine: Claude CLI 2.1.284 preserves a previously discovered deferred-tool schema across identity-preserving resume; the same BB bridge and SDK pass with CLI 2.1.245.
5479.proposedFix: Validate an upstream discovery-catalogue invalidation that preserves conversation history; rebuilding the BB MCP server already occurs and does not repair this version-dependent CLI behavior.
5479.caveats: Real bridge, SDK, CLI and successful ToolSearch with a deterministic loopback model API, repeated by the same agent in a second clean checkout. Plugin reload UI and macOS not executed. No verified safe simple context-preserving patch.
